notes.title: Update Regarding Development State
notes.notes:
Hello guys.
Long time no see.

Today we have something to tell you about Aquaculture Land. Because of several issues in the development department, we are very sorry we need to halt Aquaculture Land development since this month. It was a hard decision for us to do it. But we must do it for the good of the game itself. 

Our team needs to regularly switch tasks between Aquaculture Land and another project in the few past months. That's why the development becomes very slow. So we decided to halt the development temporarily until the team can fully focus on Aquaculture Land.

We will continue the development again when this issue is finished. We can't give you the exact time plan when we will be back, but it will be much longer than we think because our team is needed in a different department for now.

We already completed the design of the story for the campaign mode. But because of the issues, we need to postpone the update because the team still needs time to implement it in the game. Don't worry, we won't abandon Aquaculture Land. 

We have so much great feedback from you guys that need to be done and another roadmap design from us that still half developed. There are few more game design updates that we want to discuss with you guys. We will be back to Aquaculture Land for sure!

We sincerely apologize to all of you guys, to the community because we need to halt Aquaculture Land development. We hope that all of you guys will understand our decision and still support us, still giving us your feedback and suggestions for Aquaculture Land.

We will give update about the story in the next news, so you can see where the development for now.

Thank you so much for all your support so far guys. Thank you for all your feedback and suggestions, your reviews, and of course thank you so much for buying and playing Aquaculture Land. We hope we can see you guys again soon!

notes.title: Update 0.8.2 - New Worker Appearance and QoL Update!
notes.notes:
Hello!
How’s your day?

Today we are updating Aquaculture Land. In version 0.8.2, there are some changes and additions that we have added to the game. The additions and changes in version 0.8.2 also come from your feedback and suggestions. Thank you very much for your support so far, it really helps us in the development process. 

So, what are the updates this time? Without further ado, let's check it out!

Move Item Feature
The idea of the move item feature comes when you place an item in the wrong spot (aerator, generator, water filter), to put it back in the position you want, you have to sell the item first and then put the new one in the position you want. Isn't that step too long? Some of you suggested a feature that can make players easier to move the items they have installed. And then we decided to add this feature to the game.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/5303e3f7e8f0e5d7392bcbec3d5acdb8d333ec67.gif

New Worker Appearance
We changed the appearance of the workers. We feel when your farm is full of visitors who come to fish, the appearance of workers in the previous version will make them look like other visitors and sometimes make us confuse. That's why we changed their appearance, made them a uniform so that they look more stand out when in a crowd of visitors. We also try to diversify our workers so we added new workers too.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/dc3125a2e962d139373a8534e24ae6b644c4d082.gif

We also made some adjustments to existing animations such as filling water. Because we feel that the previous animation still doesn't quite match the task at hand.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/cafa3e41d1e30bb2282593c4c88ba03568fe0207.gif

Sorting and Filtering Storage
We get some feedback and suggestions on this matter. The sorting and filtering function on storage will make it easier for you to manage your fish box in storage. Because with this sorting and filtering function, it will be easier for you to know what types of fish are in your storage, which fish boxes you need to fill the request, which fish boxes are the heaviest you can sell, and so on.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/07cec88f8edbee3814885e0adeb7c450ddeb547c.gif

For more details about the updates, you can check the changelog below. Or you can try it immediately in the game.

Once again, we want to say thank you very much for all of your support so far. Thank you for all of your suggestions and feedback. We will still update the game, we still have some plans that we want to implement to Aquaculture Land. 

If you have any feedback or suggestions for today's update or about the game, feel free to tell us.

notes.title: Career Mode Come into The Main Branch! - Update version 0.8.1
notes.notes:
Hi guys!
How are you today?

A few days ago, we created a thread in the discussion section about a teaser that we move Career Mode to the main branch after the positive feedback and suggestions we got from you in 'beta Career Mode' branch. Thank you very much for your support. We really appreciate it.

And today, we have a new update for Aquaculture Land! We have moved version 0.8.1 to the main branch to replace version 0.7.11!

So for those of you who haven't had the chance to try Career Mode version 0.8.1 in the 'beta Career Mode' branch before, now all you have to do is update your Aquaculture Land and you can immediately try playing Career Mode.

We still have a lot of homework that needs to be done based on your feedback and suggestion. After this update, besides we are working on our own update list, we will also be working on your feedback and suggestion list.

Career Mode
If you have tried Career Mode in the 'beta Career Mode' branch, the Career Mode that we updated to this main branch (version 0.8.1) is more or less the same as the one in the 'beta Career Mode' branch.

In this version 0.8.1 in the main branch, we bring back Free Mode into the game. And in version 0.8.1, there are also some new things (especially the gameplay and features) that might look and feel different from version 0.7.11.

Customer Request
In version 0.7.11, to get money, aside from selling fish to the market, you must complete an order from a customer. The customer will ask you to give them amount of fish according to the order and if you can complete the order according to the requirement and before the deadline runs out, you will get a reward.

Order in version 0.7.11
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/1cf35c0991be29ef496cc255e2203f62503fbb04.gif


But in version 0.8.1, it becomes different. Customers are no longer just order number of fish, but they will give you a variety of requests, we called it “Customer Request”. There is a request that needs you to deliver an amount of fish to the customer, there is also a request asking you to sell your fish to the market.

Besides getting money for the rewards, by completing requests from customers, you will also get exp. point for Customer Relationship Level.

Customer Request in version 0.8.1
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/a44d31923b8e7f356fbbe5e000708f26b92a9c28.gif


A New Way to Unlock
Another thing that’s different in version 0.8.1 is a way to unlock something. In version 0.7.11, everything about unlocking is related to the farm level. When the farm level reaches a certain level then you can unlock something new.

Progress in version 0.7.11
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/49f578ebf8262329c3e1612d18c267fe7fc4fe82.gif

With the Customer Relationship Level system in version 0.8.1, everything about unlocking things will be related to the level of your Customer Relationship. You have to reach a certain level from a certain customer if you want to unlock something.

In version 0.8.1, there is also a new feature called the Journal Map. This Journal Map is a place if you want to see how's your progress so far. Journal Map is also a place where you can unlock something new, whether it unlocks new features, commodity licenses, or equipment.

Journal Map in version 0.8.1
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/790f7820631ee6eaf1f532cfb7e149251712866e.gif


Free Mode
In version 0.8.1 before (when it was still in ‘beta 'Career Mode' branch), we disabled the Free Mode feature because we want you to focus on trying Career Mode. But with this update, we have reactivated the Free Mode feature so that you who want to play Aquaculture Land with certain conditions or states can try it out.

For Free Mode in version 0.8.1 will be different from version 0.7.0. We're adjusting the Free Mode with the existing features (Career Mode features).

In this Free Mode, you can choose your starting condition such as equipment availability, feature availability, and customer availability. You can choose to start the game in a normal way (all things locked) or unlocked it all.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/bc6f89d3a86bc049360920819d2ee728257a3af0.gif

Move version 0.8.1 into Main Branch
As mentioned above, version 0.8.1 is different from version 0.7.11 both in terms of features or gameplay because of Career Mode. 

There is a thing to note if you want to play version 0.8.1 on the main branch:
The Career Mode version is using a different save file format, so you need to play a clean start from new game.
We hope you can understand this.

We don't completely remove version 0.7.11. We just move it to another branch. So, if you still want to play version 0.7.11, you can follow the steps here (in the second comments).

--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

There are still 5 more types of customer requests and the continuation of the story on Career Mode that we will update into the game. We hope we can show it to you soon.

That’s it for today’s update news, we will end it here so those of you who haven't tried Career Mode, can try it right away. If you have any suggestions or feedback about today’s update, feel free to tell us. We hope you will enjoy playing Aquaculture Land with today’s update.

Follow our Twitter: https://twitter.com/MaulidanGames

Have a good day.
Cheers!

notes.title: Update 0.7.10(1) - Visual Feedback for Your Pond & Custom Game
notes.notes:
Hello guys
How’s your day?

Today we have some updates for Aquaculture Land. For a few past weeks, we updated custom mode into experimental build because we still need to adjust a few things. And today, we decided to move custom mode to the main build along with the visual feedback update.

Custom Mode
There isn't much change from the custom mode that we update to the main build. Custom mode is an additional feature for Free Mode. The custom mode feature is created because we want to retain the essence of Free Mode, where players are free to play as they wish, with a progression process, where all features such as fish and equipment are locked so that players can unlock these features one by one and feel the progression.

With this feature, you can choose your starting conditions to play in Free Mode (like Sandbox Mode in general). There are several conditions that you can choose such as starting level, starting money, fish, and equipment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/4eac993c7b31cddd6a8f13bdb819d26a7080fd4e.gif

Visual Feedback
Visual feedback is one of the things that is lacking in Aquaculture Land. We realized it after watching some players playing Aquaculture Land. We also got some feedback that said they don’t know what is happening with their farm. So, we decided to add this visual feedback to help players understand what is happening with their farm, especially with their fish.

Pond Sign
Every pond you build has several statuses. You need to make sure that the statuses meet the commodities needs. Your commodities will be in bad condition if you don’t meet those needs.

For the current version, everything that happened with the status will be shown with the bubble icon (that represented the status that changed). So, if in the previous version there was only a warning icon that appears after the status going bad, right now every time the pond status increase or decreases, you’ll be shown with a bubble status icon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/84aee63323a55d32694c45f730a0184ad2946996.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/a46044b79b5f5fde13aaf517cd67b9d1eef29896.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/83c6f171acf2c4002826da4863c322b068be66fa.gif

We also changed the pond warning icon with the new one, because we thought the old one is not clear enough to tell you what the icon means.

Work Sign
Work sign is a sign that will appear every time your worker will do something. Dig pond, fill water, cut bush, repairing equipment, etc. We changed the worker sign because we want to make this sign clear enough to understand. And we also give a little animation to the sign so it will become juicier.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/174513d1e66d6ac0bfb950a4982d83e56b0d69ef.gif

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/03cc33243154fe177d74c607b8f3984fb184c7e3.gif

-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------

We hope today’s update will make you more enjoyable to play Aquaculture Land. Do you feel helped by this visual feedback? Do you find it easier to know the state of your pond with this visual feedback? We will still improve the game as much as we can. That’s why if you have any feedback or suggestions that can make you more enjoyable to play, feel free to tell us.

notes.title: Update 0.7.10(EX 1) - Custom Mode
notes.notes:
Hello.
How are you today?

Today we will discuss a new update that consists of custom mode. Before discussing further, we need to inform you that from today, every time we update the game that related balancing, features, redesign, etc, we will update the game in the experimental branch (you can read how to access experimental branch here). 

We're doing this so that this new feature that we still need to test and get feedback won't affect the main build. So, until this feature is certain that there are no bugs or are completely stable, we will use the experimental branch for the updates.

---------------------------------------------------------------

Custom Mode
So, Custom mode is an additional feature that we introduce in Free Mode. From the start, Free Mode was designed to make players can do whatever they want. They can try all the features that we have like Aerator, electricity source, fish, and other features available from the beginning of the game. But we feel that with the current situation, players will get bored quickly and some features such as diversity of pond equipment (aerator, electricity source, and filter) will not really be felt by the player.

So we planned to lock these features where later players could open them over time. That way the progression process will be felt. But if we do that, then the main purpose of the Free Mode (where players can freely try everything) will be limited. That's why we use custom mode ideas. With this feature, you can choose your starting conditions to play in Free Mode (like Sandbox Mode in general). There are several conditions that you can choose such as starting level, starting money, fish, and equipment.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/4eac993c7b31cddd6a8f13bdb819d26a7080fd4e.gif

We have updated these new changes to the experimental branch. If you want to try, you can access it in the experimental build branch (you can read how to access experimental branch here).
Please use a different save file if you try the experimental build branch so it won't affect the save file from your main build branch.

Update 0.7.9(4) for Main Build
We also update the main build into 0.7.9(4) version. In update 0.7.9 (4) we did some bug fixes that occurred in the previous version. We also do optimization on this version to prevent crashes.

---------------------------------------------------------------

If you find any bugs or you have suggestions and feedback about this new updates or anything about Aquaculture Land, feel free to tell us. Your feedback, suggestions, and reviews are an important thing to make Aquaculture Land better.

And if you don't know yet, now we've opened our Discord server. Come and join us! We can talk about all things related to the game. You can tell us all of your suggestions and feedback. 

If you want to join our Discord server, you can join here: https://discord.gg/Fkk2wsC

https://store.steampowered.com/app/858630/Aquaculture_Land/

Have a great day.
Cheers!

notes.title: Update Patch Version 0.7.9 (Build 3)
notes.notes:
Hello.
How are you?

Last week, after we launch version 0.7.9 to main build, we got feedback that said the game become harder (in a bad way). Before, we try to balance the economic system by adding new features such as upkeep costs and fish license tax. We also make you pay an amount of money to breed fish and to buy fish licenses so you can unlock new fish. And at the end of the week and month, you will pay expenses from all those features.  But once again, just like the feedback said, that makes the game become harder in a bad way. 

Coming with this patch, we try to reduce the expenses by removing the fish license tax. So, for expenses, you just need to pay the upkeep cost. We also change the paid time from weekly and monthly to monthly only. One of the reasons why we change to monthly only because we got feedback that said the expenses has come too quickly. Before they can make some money from their fish, they already told to pay some expenses. We try to recheck it and then decided to remove the weekly expenses.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33884897/792f4fb8558435443bfca67ec6c5efe63e96a148.gif

Another issue that we got from the feedback is the crash issue. We also try to fix the crash issue in this patch. The crash issue was caused by a memory leak that happened while playing the game. We already tried to optimize the memory usage and did a few tests to prevent this from happening again. But, if you still encounter the crash issue, just let us know as soon as possible.

We also make a little change to the UI UX design. We rearrange the position of UI to make it more comfortable to look and use. We still try to find the best way to show every single UI in the game.

Balancing will be one of our concerns for now. We also rechecking the system design and still figuring out how’s the best way to deliver the system so every player will enjoy playing, even the new one. Lately, we want to try to add some notifications for every event that happens in the game. Because we think there are still many values and solutions for a problem that we haven't stated clearly. We hope that notifications will help player to know what’s going on and know what to do. We hope all of the changes that come with today’s patch will make you more comfortable and enjoy playing Aquaculture Land.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/858630/Aquaculture_Land/

Last but not least, we want to say thank you so much for all your support. Thank you for playing our game, for giving us your honest reviews about the game, your feedback and suggestions, we really appreciate it. All of those things are really help us to make Aquaculture Land better. 

As always, if you have any feedback or suggestions about the game, feel free to tell us in the discussion or in the comment section below. We will always wait for your feedback, suggestions, and reviews because those are important things to us.

Have a nice day.
Cheers.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/04fb0b373972df7166a188b73323226d9cfdaa2b.gif

Hi guys
Long time no see. How are you?

This past few weeks we're focused on fixing bug and optimized the experimental build. We try to make the experimental build become more stable. And finally, in this new update, the current build is stable enough. We move the current build into the main build so you guys can try it out. You can try all features from the experimental build in this latest update and of course more optimized and stable. Besides the features, we give another touch to the current build. What is that another touch? Let's check today's update out!

Fishing Pond
We got feedback that said it takes a long time to earn some money from selling fish because you need to wait for a while until your fish is big enough to be sold. While you're waiting, you won't get any income. That's why we make this fishing pond feature so while you waiting for your money from selling fish, you will still get some income from your fishing pond. Thing to remember, only level 2 fish (and above) which can be catch by visitor.

In experimental build version, visitor arrival will make the game laggy. For this update, we already did some optimized so you won't be bother by lag anymore.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/1aac84beccbc3c936b864212c4b4a725a1044036.gif

Breeding
Breeding feature is a feature that you can use to increase your fish basic status. With this feature you can increase growth speed, fish weight, and fish quality. You can make a superior fish with breeding feature.

Only your fish seed status will be increased after breeding process. If you have the same fish in your pond with your breeding fish, your fish status in your pond will not increase.

Thank you so much to @Arburtus, @Rayune, and @Sardine for giving us an idea to make this feature.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/bb50cea689a7e0fe335008f1e0e59db696683b78.gif

This feature will help you reach level 2 fish faster and heavier than the previous generation. So you can harvest your fish earlier with heavier fish. But for using this feature, you need resource called breeding points. You can get this breeding point from nurturing your fish. Every time your fish grows, you will get breeding points.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/a57b867bd4a225d2675e1356d879ff4da427f484.gif

For previous version, you can get breeding points from level 1 fish. But on this update, we did some balance and make only level 3 fish (and above) that produce breeding points. So whether you sell your biggest fish or use it to produce some amount of breed points, you choose it ːsteamhappyː

Storage
In the previous version, every time you harvest your fish, your fish box will be lying on your farm. Sometimes your fish box will block your worker path and look like a mess. Thank you to @Amnaa and @lucatolo that come with storage feature suggestion. With this storage feature, your fish box will be automatically stored into storage so make it more organized and make your farm look neater.

The other good thing from storage feature is when you want to make your fish bigger (fish that already stored) or if you want to move your fish into another pond, you can put back your fish box into your pond.

We also add a fish box counter on storage. So, with this counter, you will know how many fish boxes you have in storage without always open the storage to check it.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/a67bbb89e074a1a8098a1230e1f557082adc44f4.gif

French Language
For current version, we add new French language. Thank you so much for @CdriX for helping us with French translation this far. You can only change the game language from setting on main menu.

There will be some texts that have a smaller size than the others because when the text is translated from English to French, it becomes longer. In this new update, we use a different font with experimental build version. With this new font, the smaller text will be better and more legible than experimental build version.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/0e0fea66153cef8b86397dc69bdad8f446bcc3d7.gif

If you want to add your own language into the game, you can check Community Translation Thread in the discussion section for the details. We can’t do it alone. Let’s do some collaboration!

Game Tutorial
We finally add basic tutorial to the game. With this tutorial, we want to give a clue to our players what they need to do and pay attention to. Because we saw some people don't have any clue what to do. Especially for fish status and how to manage it. The tutorial will be the basic action you need to do for one loop gameplay, from building ponds to selling fish.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/90c6b3230234d2b614fa446063133abe8082d307.gif

Resource Bubble, Electric Item Sign, and Electric Connection Toggle UI
We add little touch to toggle pond and fish info UI. We add resource bubble, electric item sign, and electric connection toggle.

Basically this toggle UI will be used to make the object visible or invisible. Resource bubble is for every resource that has bubble appearance (like  breeding points), electric item sign will cover every sign on electric item (like on off sign), and electric connection is for connection between electricity source and other items.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33884897/7e2fbdc5ffd115b84ef4e9f155f9fcc0143e9e5b.gif

Balancing
We changed some terms that we use for fish status. We change pond density into living space, noise into acoustic comfort, fish waste into fish waste free and etc. We're doing that to make better meaning for the pond status with the status bar.

We also do the balancing on the status of pond equipment and its prices. We do that balancing so that one equipment and another will become more useful and can be used evenly. We also do some balancing on fish status, especially on their acoustic comfort. In the previous version, some of the fish statuses are too difficult to handle. For this reason, we adjust it again so the fish that raised by the player can be more diverse and the level of difficulty perceived by the player is better. 

For worker, we changed their status. We decided to delete the tenacity status. We also doing some adjustment to their status points because in the previous version, their status points are not balances enough. So, in this current version, more good your worker status, more expensive his hire price and salary.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

Finally, after a few weeks, we can update the game from experimental build into version 0.7.8. We hope with this new version, our players that haven't had time to try experimental build, they can try the new feature in this version. 

Just like our plan, after this update, we will be more focus on redesign Aquaculture Land core design. From all of feedback and suggestion we received, we feel like there is something wrong with the core design. And we need to do something about it. Therefore, after this we will rarely make significant updates. But don't worry, we will still make a list for your suggestions and feedback. Maybe we will find an idea about the redesign from your feedback and suggestions. We will also still update about the bugfix. For the details about our next move, you can check this thread

We also give you the changelog from today's update down below so you will know more about the update details. If you have feedback and suggestions about today’s update, feel free to tell us in the comment section below or in the discussion.

We want to say many thanks to all of you guys that already played our game, give us your honest review about the game, many suggestions and feedback, and other things that help us to make Aquaculture Land become a better game. Thank you for all of your support. And we hope you will still support us from now on.

See you next time guys.
Cheers!

Hello guys :)

After roughly six months in development, Aquaculture Land will finally out on Steam! Based on our experience, we learned that feedback and suggestion from communities are important for us to make our game better. Therefore, we will release Aquaculture Land as Early Access first, so players can play the game and tell us what they think about it. We want the game to be able to simulate a freshwater aquaculture business experience, while still fun to be played.

In the current state of the game, it core features have been implemented already. You will at least be able to create ponds, put some equipment to support it, nurturing fishes, and then sell them. There are some planned features to be implemented in our list before we feel it is ready to be released as full version. And while we are working to implement them, we want you to be able to play and test the current version of the game, so we can make sure if we are on the right track.
We will update the game frequently if new feature has been added. We will always try our best to make sure there will be no game-breaking bugs on each update, but please bear with us if the worst happen.

We planned to stay on Early Access for approximately four months, but it may still be changed if there are some exciting features that need to be added later. The price for Aquaculture Land may be updated along the way based on players' feedback or if a big improvement has been made.

We will read every feedback from you, so please don't hesitate to tell us what you think about it. We hope you enjoy the game!

Cheers!
